evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have

observations.why: Directive issued as standing order — 'from now on' enacts command authority; the aphoristic conditional frames non-compliance as forfeiture of capability, a rank-based allocation of what the team may claim to possess.
Assertive restatement of the mandated cadence reinforces the directive's standing-order force — the schedule is declared, not negotiated.
Naming the authority figure as the source of the directive marks rank — the directive's force is tied to the named position-holder.

mints.name: StandingOrderAsCapabilityClaim
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is authority here exercised by declaring a recurring obligation and framing non-compliance as forfeiture of a claimed capability?
